name: pixel-plugin
description: Create, animate, and export pixel art using Aseprite through natural language and commands. Supports retro palettes, animation, dithering, and game engine export.

interface.shortDescription: Create, animate, and export Aseprite pixel art
interface.longDescription: Aseprite pixel-art workflows with a bundled local MCP server. Requires Aseprite 1.3.17.2 or later.
defaultPrompt: Create a 32x32 pixel-art sprite and export it as a PNG.
